label: PF Backlog 629
title: Design System & UI/UX Knowledge (framework-agnostic)
body:
## Problem / why
PF has UI/UX pipeline stages and a guideline loader, but only ~15 KB of dated a11y guidance behind them; the rich UIUX/ corpus and the OpenCode UI/UX skills are unused and/or harness-bound.

## Goal & value
Merge the UIUX/ corpus and the OpenCode skills into a PF-owned framework-agnostic knowledge+skills base, and let PF dynamically pick a design direction from a project idea and generate end-to-end UI components. .opencode becomes a pure adapter (BI-0201/BI-0202).

## In scope
- L1 guidelines, L2 catalog+tokens, L3 skills, L4 selection, L5 agent bindings, L6 a11y/visual gates.
- New logic in Go (go/pfcore) invoked via core/go_host.py.

## Out of scope
- Redesigning the pipeline itself
- Non-UI skills
- Generated-product code changes.

## Definition of Done
- Design + seed reviewed at Gate 1; no child is marked delivered before its own AC evidence.

## Verification
Structured `acceptance_criteria` is the single source of truth for verification.

approach:

- Tokens are 3-tier OKLCH with light+dark, seeded by the chosen system.
- New logic lands in Go and passes scripts/dev/language_rule_check.py.
